queries.name: catalog
queries.description: Browse everything on offer. The whole catalogue comes back in one call, so this is the cheap way to see what exists before narrowing.

queries.name: search_hotels
queries.description: Find hotels matching what the human actually asked for; narrow with the filters this verb declares rather than pulling the whole catalogue. A row is a SUMMARY of one property, priced at its cheapest nightly rate and not at a total for the stay. The result is one PAGE of the matching set: when more hotels match, the response says so, and stopping at the first page answers from a partial list.

cursor.description: Opaque `next` cursor from a prior page.

actions.name: create_order
actions.description: Place an order for what the human has chosen. This RESERVES the goods and returns the order to settle; it does not take money -- the `pay` verb does that.
